marc:datafield.marc:subfield: FARMERS MARKET : BUILD A FARM FRESH MARKETPLACE!

Welcome to your own personal Farmers Market! Sell products like eggs, milk. beef, and corn. Combine ingredients to sell freshly-made waffles, barbecue, ice cream, fruit pies, and much more! Attract new customers with a band, and increase the price of your food with blue ribbon contests. Create markets in the city, the desert, at campgrounds the pier, and many other exciting location. It's up to you to build a bustling farm-fresh marketplace in this fun Time Management game!
